entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number is 772-B-901.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see you're one of our VIP members, thanks for being a loyal customer. I'm looking at the Trail Helmet in Forest Green. Is that the correct item?
That's the one. I want to return the helmet.
I can certainly look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong color. My wife bought it for me, but I wanted the black one. The box is still unopened.

I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety and comfort. Let me just check the purchase date... Okay, I see it was delivered 55 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window.
So, is that a yes? Can I return it or not?
Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You can just attach that to the original shipping box and drop it at any courier.

And since you're a VIP member and had this hassle, I've also added a credit for free two-day shipping to your account for your next order. That way, when you order the helmet in the color you want, you'll get it right away.
Oh. Okay, that's actually useful. Thanks.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
